text: Add a train-fitted user-by-tab categorical cross to the additive experiment-1 scorer.
rationale: Tab 0 covers 13,726 validation rows and has very weak ranking in experiment 2, while request context was the sole feature family with a positive training-only temporal screen. A user-by-tab residual tests whether tab preferences vary by user without introducing new raw fields.
exact_ablation: Relative to experiment 1, append exactly one train-fitted categorical feature for the user_id × tab cross, scored as an additive residual; retain all existing raw features, additive main effects, BCE loss, optimizer settings, split, and early stopping unchanged.

expected_effect.GAUC: Increase by 0.000 to 0.003 if user-specific tab preference improves within-user pair ordering.
expected_effect.nDCG@5: Increase by 0.001 to 0.004 if the cross corrects top-five placement in large tab cohorts, especially tab 0.
